title: Hotel Room Booking and Payments on Cardano - A Real World Use Case

ms.promise:

For this API's will be exposed to public to implement the same in their hotel booking system example Hotel Booking Engine, Central Reservation System or Online Travel Agency etc. While building this for concept, we will also demonstrate and prove the concept with some user interfaces developed by us. For this purpose, we shall build few user interface screen mock-ups as well.

ms.report:
Thank you for the clarification. We understand the concern and would like to clarify both points.
1. How can you verify that this is Hotel Trimoorti’s actual booking engine?
The HBE is integrated directly into Hotel Trimoorti’s own website: https://www.hoteltrimoorti.com/
You can visit the website and make a test booking through the hotel’s actual booking flow. The corresponding transaction can then be verified on the Cardano Testnet.
This provides a direct verification chain:
Hotel Trimoorti website → HBE → Cardano Booking & Payment API → Cardano Testnet transaction.
2. How can you verify that Hotel Trimoorti is participating?
Hotel Trimoorti has allowed us to integrate the booking engine into its own website and cooperate with us for the Testnet testing. We believe this is strong practical evidence of the hotel's participation.
In addition, written consent from the hotel is available to you on request, with personal information redacted as appropriate.
We believe the combination of the hotel's own website integration, an independently testable booking flow, verifiable Testnet transactions, and the hotel's written authorization provides sufficient evidence of both the integration and participation.
If you still require additional evidence, please let us know specifically what evidence would be acceptable, and we will be happy to provide it.
-------------------------------------------------------
